tripNotes.content:
Arrival logistics
Use an eSIM or buy a Schiphol SIM before the train into Amsterdam.
Keep a screenshot of the hotel address in case station Wi-Fi is spotty.

Private budget reminder
Leave one flexible dinner slot in Amsterdam and one in Rotterdam for splurge reservations once the weather forecast is clearer.

wishlistItems.name: Bord'eau (Hotel de l'Europe)
wishlistItems.notes: Fine dining with canal views — book well in advance

wishlistItems.name: Restaurant Moeder's
wishlistItems.notes: Old-school Dutch home cooking, cosy and very popular

wishlistItems.name: Daalder Rotterdam
wishlistItems.notes: Seasonal Dutch menu, great wine list

wishlistItems.name: Lokaal Utrecht
wishlistItems.notes: Relaxed spot for regional produce and Dutch craft beer

wishlistItems.name: De Hoofdwacht Haarlem
wishlistItems.notes: Classic Dutch kitchen in a 17th-century guard house on the Grote Markt

wishlistItems.name: Westergasfabriek complex
wishlistItems.notes: Former gas works turned cultural campus — good on a weekend for the market

wishlistItems.name: Kinderdijk windmills
wishlistItems.notes: UNESCO-listed row of 19 windmills — easy half-day from Rotterdam by water bus

wishlistItems.name: Gouda old town & cheese market
wishlistItems.notes: Beautiful Gothic town hall; cheese market runs Thursday mornings in season

wishlistItems.name: Panorama Mesdag panoramic painting
wishlistItems.notes: The largest 19th-century panoramic painting in the world, Den Haag

wishlistItems.name: Hortus Botanicus Amsterdam
wishlistItems.notes: One of the world's oldest botanical gardens — beautiful in late winter

wishlistItems.name: Walk in Amsterdamse Bos
wishlistItems.notes: Big urban forest south of the city — rent a bike or just stroll the trails

wishlistItems.name: Het Park stroll (Rotterdam)
wishlistItems.notes: Quiet landscaped park next to the Euromast; great for a morning walk

wishlistItems.name: Haagse Bos forest walk
wishlistItems.notes: Ancient woodland right in the city — connects to the royal Huis ten Bosch gardens
